name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
Major upgrade since v2.3.2

🐞 Fixed: projects with non-Latin keys missing from the picker — A project whose key starts with a digit or contains Cyrillic/a hyphen (e.g. «1С ЗУП» / 1c_demo) was silently absent from the planner's project picker. Key validation is now permissive (any real YouTrack key) and the project-list caps were raised.

🔗 Shareable sprint links — The page address now reflects the selected project, sprint and section; the «Share» button in the navigation panel copies a deep link. Open it and a colleague lands on the same view — ideal for handing work off (e.g. a dev lead assigns executors). The link only navigates; what the recipient can do (view or edit) is governed by their YouTrack access.

🗂 Sprint Planner in the YouTrack main menu — The full planner now lives in the YouTrack main menu under «Smart Sprint Planner» — pick a project in the header and start planning. No more clicking into project settings every day. The project-settings widget remains, but is narrowed down to configuration only (roles, fields, modes).

🔗 One-Click Project Connection — Connecting a project to the planner is now a single action: pick a settings-manager group in the project widget once, and the project appears in the main-menu planner for everyone with access to it. Until the group is set, the project stays hidden from the menu and its settings stay read-only — no accidental edits on a fresh install.

🖥 Wide-Screen «Rail + Pane» Dashboard — On a wide screen (≥1330 px) the planner splits into a slim ~210 px navigation rail (project & sprint context, navigation tree) on the left and a wide work area on the right. Tables, the Gantt chart and forms finally have room to breathe. On a narrow screen — the familiar single-column stack. The rail collapses to a 28 px sliver with one click.

🌳 Navigation Tree Instead of Tabs — The old tab bar is replaced with a clear navigation tree in the rail: Sprint parameters · Planning (Allocation / Distribution / Stand-up) · Gantt chart · Sprint history. All sections are visible at once and one click away; the active sprint's full name is shown right under the sprint picker so you never lose context.

📑 Dedicated «Sprint Parameters» Screen — The cramped «Inputs» card that used to sit above the planning tabs becomes a roomy page of its own with a clean two-column layout (Name + Goal, Dates + Sprint + Version). No more squeezing the sprint goal into a single line.

🕰 Historical Sprint Shows Its Own Data — When you select a finished sprint, «Sprint parameters» and the role composition are now read from the history snapshot — not from the active sprint. Fixed an old confusion where switching to a past sprint kept showing today's name, dates and team.

🔢 Per-Assignee Distribution Totals Work Again — The resource totals and «used» column in the per-assignee distribution table were silently broken since v2.2.0 (a dead-code audit removed two helper functions). Restored — real numbers instead of «—».

🛟 Sprint Selection Is Preserved — Switching to the «Per-assignee distribution» level from a non-active sprint no longer jumps you back to the current sprint. Your explicit selection is respected across level changes.

🔍 Compatibility — YouTrack 2024.3+. Drop-in upgrade — no schema migration, no data loss. Existing project settings (roles, fields, manager group) are reused as-is.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), estimate and spent fields, planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project.
